steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow the buyer to add the QA vendor during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and award the entire lot to one vendor.
Provide the mandatory event title while allowing the runner to generate a unique title.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity 10.
Confirm the requested product was added to the first sheet row.
Confirm the requested quantity is 10.
Confirm the product's automatically filled variant.
Choose the specified delivery location.
Verify the selected delivery location remained in the sheet.
Complete any remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Commit a one-hour event duration before publishing; the exact absolute start is handled by the closest supported reschedule step.
Invite one QA test vendor without inventing a supplier name.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move the published event to a supported future start so it is upcoming rather than live.
Verify the project is still upcoming and can be rescheduled.
Return to the events list to verify the event's list state.
Open the Live tab where future-start events are listed.
Confirm this plan's published RFQ appears in the Live tab.
Verify the listed event is upcoming and not live yet.
